description: This file defines React components and utility functions for managing and displaying snapshots in a trace viewer UI, including snapshot collection, rendering, and inspection controls.

classes.name: HighlightedElement
classes.description: Type defining a highlighted element with optional locator and ariaSnapshot, and lastEdited state.

classes.name: Snapshot
classes.description: Type representing a snapshot associated with an action, including optional point and input target flag.

classes.name: SnapshotInfo
classes.description: Type containing URL and viewport details of a snapshot.

classes.name: Snapshots
classes.description: Type grouping optional before, after, and action snapshots.

classes.name: SnapshotUrls
classes.description: Type containing URLs for snapshot info, snapshot, and popout view.

methods.name: collectSnapshots
methods.description: Collects and constructs snapshots (before, after, action) related to a given action.

methods.name: extendSnapshot
methods.description: Generates URLs for snapshot views based on trace URI and snapshot data.

methods.name: fetchSnapshotInfo
methods.description: Fetches snapshot metadata from a URL.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot object from an action and snapshot type key.
